name: 3D Grid Rasterization
definition: Voxelize a mesh and snap the resulting voxel centers to a fixed-width, height, and depth 3D grid, returning a flat array of ABGR colors.
summary: 3D Grid Rasterization converts triangle meshes into voxel grids by projecting them onto orthogonal planes using GPU fragment shaders, differing from CPU methods by leveraging hardware rasterization.
